scope.summary: Implement a vector object's stroke as an ordered stack of stroke entries paralleling fills, each accepting multiple stacked paint fills with per-fill opacity/blend, and carrying weight (per-side all/top/bottom/left/right/custom), align (center/inside/outside), caps (butt/round/projecting), joins (miter/round/bevel + miter angle/limit), dashes (N dash/gap pairs, dash cap, align-to-corners, dotted preset), arrowheads (start/end markers with scale/swap/alignment), and dynamic stroke (wobble frequency/wiggle/smoothen); caps/joins/arrowheads defined for open + closed + branching network endpoints (3+ incident edges resolved per edge).
expected_tests: argus: strokes panel reachable via author_id
test: weight/align/caps/joins/dashes/arrowheads/dynamic applied; branching-endpoint cap/join resolved per incident edge (no undefined rendering)
acceptance_criteria_original: stroke stack + full attribute set + defined branching endpoints; author_ids + manual entry

target_entries: Studio / Vector / Strokes (weight, caps, joins, dashes, arrowheads)

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: **[STU-VEC-020]** A vector object's stroke MUST be expressed as an ordered stack of stroke entries paralleling fills ([STU-VEC-015]); each stroke entry MUST accept multiple stacked paint fills with per-fill opacity and blend behaviour, and MUST carry the attributes defined in [STU-VEC-143] through [STU-VEC-148]. No captured attribute is dropped in dedup.

**[STU-VEC-062]** Caps/joins/arrowhead configuration MUST be defined for both simple open-path endpoints and for closed or branching (network) endpoints; where a network anchor terminates three or more edges, Studio MUST provide advanced endpoint controls resolving cap/join rendering per incident edge, and MUST NOT leave branching-endpoint rendering undefined. The per-vertex cap and join fields of [STU-VEC-108] are the storage for that resolution.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
